opening.label: Opening
opening.title: Opening
opening.intro: Default: establish recovery and growth, then support the guns. These are priorities, not fixed turn deadlines. Archive-derived priority guidance from the atlas's September 2026 research, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: The Way of the Guilds → Heavy Quernstones
steps.note: Open the civilian branch and obtain early growth.

steps.title: Khazid Subsidies → Rat Poison
steps.note: Settlement-development savings followed by campaign replenishment. Rat Poison is a practical priority for repeated battles.

steps.title: Marching Songs → Gather the Throngs
steps.note: Open the military routes and lower infantry recruitment costs.

steps.title: Vanguard Proficiency → Masterwork Crossbows
steps.note: Useful while Quarrellers dominate. Skip the crossbow follow-up if you are already converting rapidly to Thunderers.

steps.title: Superior Black Powder → Renowned Deadeyes
steps.note: The gun-infantry branch after Vanguard Proficiency. It supports Thunderers and Slayer Pirates—not your Cannons.

steps.title: Dwarf Treasuries when the capital grows
steps.note: Returns to the Khazid Subsidies branch. Use spare research time when immediate battle needs are covered.

details: One decision rule

If losses are forcing idle turns, finish recovery first. If your screen collapses, detour through Militia Training → Call to Clan → Iron Readiness. If your existing army wins cleanly, develop income rather than buying irrelevant combat bonuses.
Research is separate from Adventures
Grapeshot comes from the Cannon Adventure preparation. It is not unlocked by Superior Black Powder, and you do not need to finish the entire technology tree before obtaining it.

gunline.label: Gunline
gunline.title: Gunline
gunline.intro: Build the artillery branch once its preceding military gate is open. Buy technology for your actual composition. Archive-derived priority guidance from the atlas's September 2026 research, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Militia Training → Call to Clan → Iron Readiness
steps.note: The shielded Warrior/Longbeard route. Interlocking Shields is an optional manual formation upgrade afterwards.

steps.title: Warrior’s Guild gate → Retainers’ Vows
steps.note: Satisfy the preceding military block in your live tree. Do not treat Retainers’ Vows as a turn-one root.

steps.title: Large Scale Shell Production
steps.note: The artillery ammunition/damage node after Retainers’ Vows.

steps.title: Field Engineers → Artillery Entrenchment
steps.note: Follow the artillery chain for sustained fire and protection.

steps.title: Renowned Deadeyes → Iron Price
steps.note: A useful upkeep follow-up for a Thunderer-heavy army.

steps.title: Veteran Ironbreaker improvements
steps.note: Tales of Many Wars belongs later, with eligible high-rank infantry. Do not rush a rank-7 benefit for fresh recruits.

details: Follow the gates
The military blocks have prerequisite-count requirements. Buy the highlighted prerequisites in your actual tree; these are priorities, not claims that every node is selectable immediately.
Support the actual army
Two Organ Guns do not justify neglecting a damaged screen. Replenishment and upkeep improvements can be more useful than another specialised weapon bonus.

air.label: Air wing
air.title: Air wing
air.intro: Only elevate these priorities when your recruited aircraft justify them. A summoned ship alone is not the whole template. Archive-derived priority guidance from the atlas's September 2026 research, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Retainers’ Vows
steps.note: The same later military gateway as the artillery branch.

steps.title: Heavy Armour Plating
steps.note: Protection for Gyrocopters, Gyrobombers and Thunderbarges.

steps.title: Interchangeable Parts
steps.note: Aircraft recovery and upkeep reduction; particularly useful for expensive recruited barges.

steps.title: Improved Gyrocopter Engines
steps.note: Mobility and deployment benefits. Check the unit list: the fire-while-moving addition excludes Brimstone Guns.

steps.title: Match the relevant Adventure
steps.note: Dreadquake for your gyro group; The Skaven Scheme for recruited Thunderbarges once unlocked.

steps.title: Return to the ground army
steps.note: Keep the infantry and supporting Thunderers competitive. Your air wing still needs a functioning ground force.

details: Generic armies
Faction-level research is reusable. Malakai’s personal skill effects, ship support radius and the Spirit summon are separate; do not silently add them to a distant generic force.

economy.label: Holds & economy
economy.title: Holds & economy
economy.intro: Develop the income and recruitment base needed for this route; there is no fixed province ceiling. Archive-derived priority guidance from the atlas's September 2026 research, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Dwarf Treasuries → High King’s Authority
steps.note: Improve settlement income/development after the early recovery foundation.

steps.title: Construction Guilds when opening the Deeps
steps.note: A targeted detour when clearing blocked underground space is actually your next investment. Follow its highlighted prerequisites.

steps.title: Income techs matching local buildings
steps.note: Favour improvements to the mines, trade and industry you really built—not a resource type your realm does not produce.

steps.title: Operations Training when hero capacity is tight
steps.note: Consider the Engineer-capacity/research branch once its civilian prerequisites are met.

steps.title: Oath Stones much later
steps.note: An all-unit upkeep goal after Ancestral Tombs. Do not abandon immediate needs to rush a distant capstone.

steps.title: Stop buying irrelevant branches
steps.note: A completed campaign does not require an entirely completed research tree.

details: Civilian and military progression
Alternate according to the bottleneck. A turn spent on growth or recovery can be more useful than advancing a specialist weapon you do not yet own.
Deeps caution
A technology that clears tunnels makes underground development possible; it does not make the project free. Budget the entrance, cleared space and income-producing buildings together.

slayers.label: Slayers
slayers.title: Support the Slayer crew
slayers.intro: Keep the crew alive long enough to do its job; do not confuse unbreakable with durable. Archive-derived priority guidance from the atlas's September 2026 research, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Marching Songs → Gather the Throngs
steps.note: Enter the military progression and support recruitment before pursuing a distant capstone.

steps.title: Superior Black Powder → Renowned Deadeyes
steps.note: After Vanguard Proficiency; this gun-infantry branch includes Slayer Pirates. Cannon upgrades are a different branch.

steps.title: Slayer upgrades: check the unit list
steps.note: Prioritise your live tree’s nodes explicitly covering the Slayers, Giant Slayers, Pirates or Doomseekers you are actually fielding.

steps.title: Slayer’s Onslaught, once its gate opens
steps.note: A later charge/Slayer benefit, with an extra Doomseeker effect for eligible veterans. Do not rush a rank-gated effect for new units.

steps.title: Artillery path for Goblin Hewers
steps.note: Retainers’ Vows and the artillery path support the Hewer’s weapon role. The infantry red-line skill Grimnir’s Heirs is not its direct substitute.

steps.title: Return to recovery and the escort
steps.note: Rat Poison and the Warrior/Longbeard protection path remain useful; dead veterans cost more than a patient recovery turn.

details: Skill points versus technology
Grimnir’s Heirs / Honoured by Grimnir are lord skills. Slayer’s Onslaught is technology. Adventures are a third, separate source of improvements.

route-route-1.label: Route order
route-route-1.title: Research · Northern kingdom
route-route-1.intro: A practical priority queue. The other tabs show the named branch paths and exceptions. Archive-derived Route I expedition order, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Guilds → Heavy Quernstones
steps.note: Growth is important because the capital landmark and the conquered realm both need development.

steps.title: Khazid Subsidies → Rat Poison
steps.note: Development savings and replenishment help repeated conquest. Follow the civilian prerequisite chain.

steps.title: Dwarf Treasuries → High King’s Authority
steps.note: Bring forward broad settlement development rather than an early tall-only project.

steps.title: Military gates → Retainers’ Vows
steps.note: Work through the live military prerequisites while supporting the early escort and Cannon battery.

steps.title: Heavy Armour Plating → Interchangeable Parts
steps.note: Aircraft defence, recovery and upkeep fit the larger recruited flight.

steps.title: Improved Gyrocopter Engines; escort support
steps.note: Complete the useful aviation path, then maintain the infantry/artillery. The reward is not active until actually received.

details: This is a strategic queue, not another technology tree
The named branch paths hold the detailed steps. This route card changes the order in which those paths matter; it does not duplicate shared research progress.
Change priority when the army changes
Air development and a sustainable second field army
Research for the actual bottleneck
Surface growth, income and a tier-IV Kraka Drak
The atlas's earlier expedition-path names

Growth and replenishment foundation; support the artillery you actually deploy; do not abandon the Slayer troop families; add the aviation path when the test flight grows; protect the escort rather than replacing the theme; revisit priorities when you change expedition.

route-route-2.title: Research · Dark Fortresses
route-route-2.intro: A practical priority queue. The other tabs show the named branch paths and exceptions. Archive-derived Route II expedition order, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Guilds → Quernstones → Khazid Subsidies
steps.note: Start the growth/development base; do not research the entire civil tree before leaving.

steps.title: Rat Poison
steps.note: Recovery is a leading operational priority, especially with Slayer casualties.

steps.title: Military opening → escort protection
steps.note: Use Marching Songs / Gather the Throngs and the Warrior/Longbeard path as the live gates require.

steps.title: Retainers’ Vows → shell-production path
steps.note: Support Cannons and Hewers. Continue Field Engineers / Artillery Entrenchment as available.

steps.title: Black Powder → Deadeyes; Slayer branch
steps.note: Pirates use gun-infantry support; Slayer infantry needs its own coverage. Use the Slayer tab for the distinction.

steps.title: Aircraft recovery only for an actual flight
steps.note: Interchangeable Parts matters when aircraft are a recurring expense. Otherwise prioritise escort/Slayer improvements and the next operation.

route-route-3.intro: A practical priority queue. The other tabs show the named branch paths and exceptions. Archive-derived Route III expedition order, not a fixed buy order or a current-build test — live technology names, ordering and prerequisite gates are unverified; inspect the live technology tree and follow its visible gates before spending.

steps.title: Guilds → Heavy Quernstones
steps.note: A healthy home economy is the launch point, not the entire campaign.

steps.title: Khazid Subsidies → Rat Poison
steps.note: Reduce development friction and spend less time unable to continue an operation.

steps.title: Military opening → guns and escort
steps.note: Follow the Opening tab. Prioritise the units actually available; crossbow support is optional when transitioning quickly.

steps.title: Retainers’ Vows → artillery path
steps.note: Invest in the Cannon/Hewer core, then the mixed battery. This is separate from Adventure upgrades.

steps.title: Treasuries + matching trade / income
steps.note: Support a coalition and useful former-enemy holdings. Buy resource bonuses only when the economy uses them.

steps.title: Aviation later; Oath Stones if worthwhile
steps.note: The barge escort is a destination, not a gate to victory. Do not delay the last faction war to complete an unrelated technology branch.
